label: conj:qou-p-neq-np
title: $\mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP}$ at non-torsion $q \in \mathbb{G}_m$
html:
Conjecture (\mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} in the QOU). Given a QOU with physical non-torsion substrate parameter q_0 \in \mathbb{G}_m^{\mathrm{nt}}(\mathbb{R}), \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} holds in that QOU. This is a conditional statement: the QOU axioms are its hypothesis — it is not a claim about \mathrm{P} versus \mathrm{NP} in the abstract, and no result here would prove the unconditional Clay problem. Equivalently, the resolution-tree evaluation of the universal obstruction class \chi(A) is non-vanishing:

  \mathrm{res}_{\mathcal{R}}\!\bigl(\chi(A)\bigr)  \neq  0 \qquad\text{at } q = q_0.

The Lean carrier makes the conditioning explicit: qou_implies_p_neq_np derives the QOU-scoped separation PNeqNPInQOU from a QouPNeqNp instance (the QOU faithfulness hypothesis) — it never concludes a bare \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP}.

Established complexity landscape (chippable kernel). The concrete computational object attached to a link L = \hat{\beta} is its Jones invariant J_L(q) = \mathrm{tr}_M(\rho(\beta)), and its complexity is a theorem, stratified by the arithmetic of q:

  • Exact evaluation is \#\mathrm{P}-hard at all but finitely many q (Jaeger--Vertigan--Welsh). The only classically poly-time points are the roots of unity of order n \mid 6 — the values q \in \{1, -1, \pm i, e^{\pm i\pi/3}\}.
  • Additive approximation is \mathrm{BQP}-complete at a primitive root of unity of order n \nmid 6 (Aharonov--Jones--Landau; Freedman--Kitaev--Larsen--Wang).

This stratification is cited fact, not a QOU derivation. Crucially, \#\mathrm{P}-hardness of one invariant's exact evaluation does not separate \mathrm{P} from \mathrm{NP}: it concerns counting, not decision, and no known reduction turns it into a \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} proof.

The \mathbb{G}_m-torsion stratification (corrected). Earlier drafts stated the torsion dichotomy backwards. The correct picture, matching the citations above:

Regime Value of q Jones complexity
Classically transparent torsion, order n \mid 6 poly-time (JVW tractable set)
Quantum-hard torsion, order n \nmid 6 \mathrm{BQP}-complete additive approximation (AJL)
Counting-hard non-torsion q_0 \#\mathrm{P}-hard exact evaluation (JVW)

At a torsion root of unity of order n \mid 6 the Iwahori--Hecke algebra degenerates just enough that the invariant collapses to a poly-time formula. This — not torsion in general — is the transparent regime. At other roots of unity the algebra supports the AJL quantum algorithm (\mathrm{BQP}). At the non-torsion substrate value q_0 the algebra is semisimple and exact evaluation is \#\mathrm{P}-hard.

Kummer persistence. The Kummer filtration yields \kappa_c^{\mathrm{comp}} \bmod n = 0 if and only if n \mid 6 — precisely the JVW classically-tractable set. Because q_0 is strictly non-torsion, no finite Kummer level applies: q_0 sits permanently outside the transparent set.

What is conjectural (the irreducible gap). The step from the established "\#\mathrm{P}-hard exact Jones evaluation at q_0" to the asserted "\mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP}" is an analogy, not a theorem. Two things are unproven; together they are the open, un-instantiated faithful field of the Lean carrier QouPNeqNp — which is itself sorry-free (the gap is carried as a class hypothesis, never an axiom or instance; a fabricated instance would launder the conjecture into a proof):

  1. that the resolution-tree residue \mathrm{res}_{\mathcal{R}}(\chi(A)) is a faithful invariant of the \mathrm{P}-vs-\mathrm{NP} decision boundary, rather than of the (easier-to-obstruct) counting problem; and
  2. that its non-vanishing at q_0 is equivalent to \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} rather than merely implied by it.

A concrete non-vanishing of \chi(A) at generic q_0 is a Zariski-open (hence generically true, easy) condition; it therefore cannot by itself discharge the conjecture without collapsing the claimed equivalence. This genericity is itself Lean-proved, sorry-free, in the companion module ObstructionGenericity: a nonzero polynomial obstruction vanishes at only finitely many parameter values (obstruction_vanishing_locus_finite), so its non-vanishing locus over an infinite domain is cofinite, hence infinite (obstruction_nonvanishing_locus_infinite) — stated over a generic integral domain, with no archimedean input. This is the chippable boundary: everything above the line is cited or provable; only the analogy remains open.

The non-vanishing leg is an axiom consequence modulo the branch-point count. Two of its three legs come from the axioms: the observability axiom kills HH^0, and the Frobenius--Hopf self-duality induces the Yekutieli--Van den Bergh Poincaré duality on Hochschild cohomology so that HH^2 \cong (HH^1)^\vee \cong k (obstruction reduction). The third leg, the Riemann--Roch / branch-point chain that pins the scalar to -6 (the \chi(A) = -6 chain), reads its branch-point count off Bring's surface rather than deriving it, so the value is located within the axiom cone rather than forced by it. With q_0 strictly non-torsion, the Kummer filtration then yields \mathrm{res}_{\mathcal{R}}(\chi(A)) \neq 0 at q_0 — and no step of that chain refers to computational complexity. This sharpens the collapse observation above: were the asserted equivalence a theorem, \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} would follow from the QOU axioms by the eight-step chain alone. The conjecture's entire open content therefore lives in items 1--2 (faithfulness of the residue for the decision boundary), not in the non-vanishing.

Chipping the equivalence. The conjectured equivalence decomposes into two directions, formalized sorry-free in the companion module PNeqNpEquivalence (the class ResidueFaithfulness carries soundness \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} \Rightarrow \mathrm{res} \neq 0 and faithfulness \mathrm{res} \neq 0 \Rightarrow \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} as separate hypotheses, and the equivalence is derived from them). Given the derived non-vanishing, three facts are machine-checked: soundness is automatic and carries no computational content (sound_of_residual_ne_zero); asserting the equivalence is exactly asserting \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} (equivalence_collapse); and the Kummer reduction of the derived value vanishes exactly at the Jaeger--Vertigan--Welsh tractable levels, -6 \bmod n = 0 \iff n \mid 6, with any real q > 1 non-torsion (chi_mod_vanishes_iff, nontorsion_of_one_lt). The single irreducible open item is the faithfulness direction; \mathrm{P}, \mathrm{NP} remain an opaque proposition pending a formal complexity-theory layer.

The counting–decision gap (companion statement). Every citable hardness result at q_0 concerns counting: Jaeger--Vertigan--Welsh give \#\mathrm{P}-hardness of exact evaluation, and \mathrm{NP} \subseteq \mathrm{P}^{\#\mathrm{P}} makes \mathrm{FP} \neq \#\mathrm{P} a consequence of \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} — the weaker separation (counting_sep_of_decision_sep). These enter the formalization as the cited hypothesis class JonesComplexityCitations (carried in the type, never instantiated — a fabricated instance would launder literature into a proof). Modulo that class and the residue--semisimplicity bridge, the reachable companion faithfulness is machine-checked: if \mathrm{FP} \neq \#\mathrm{P}, a surviving residue forces exact Jones evaluation at q_0 out of \mathrm{FP} (counting_faithfulness). Upgrading this to the conjectured \mathrm{res} \neq 0 \Rightarrow \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} requires exactly two open inputs, displayed as the hypotheses of faithfulness_of_transfer: the counting separation \mathrm{FP} \neq \#\mathrm{P} itself, and a counting\todecision transfer that no known result supplies. Discharging those two hypotheses is precisely what a proof of this conjecture must add. The bridge — semisimplicity of H_n(q_0) via Wenzl's root-of-unity criterion — is the one front where ordinary (non-millennium) mathematics can still advance the conjecture, and its parameter side is done: WenzlGeneric formalizes "q^k \neq 1 for 2 \leq k \leq n" over a generic monoid, wenzlGeneric_of_one_lt proves every real q > 1 satisfies it at every rank, and counting_faithfulness_of_one_lt composes end-to-end — for the substrate q_0 > 1, given \mathrm{FP} \neq \#\mathrm{P}, exact Jones evaluation is not polynomial-time, sorry-free modulo the two cited classes (WenzlCriterion, JonesComplexityCitations). Notably the obstruction residual drops out of this reachable statement entirely: the counting hardness at q_0 rests on parameter genericity alone. Stage 2 advances this on the Schur-element side (WenzlSchurElement infrastructure): semisimplicity is governed by non-vanishing of the Schur elements of the symmetrizing trace, and schurElement_ne_zero proves — sorry-free, on the concrete Schur element s_{\lambda,X}(Q) = Q^{n(\lambda)} \prod_x (1 - X Q^{c(x)})/(1 - Q^{h(x)}) — that in the regime Q > 1, X \leq 0 every Schur element is nonzero (positive hook lengths make every denominator strictly negative; nonpositive X makes every numerator positive). The Geck--Pfeiffer criterion enters as the cited class SchurElementCriterion, and semisimple_of_substrate discharges semisimplicity at every rank with the Schur leg computed rather than assumed. For physical Markov specialisations X = Q^{-N} > 0 the numerator factors genuinely vanish at cells of content N — the Temperley--Lieb quotient stratification. That is no longer a follow-on: it is proved sorry-free in WenzlSchurElement (tl_numerator_eq_zero_iff, schurElement_tl_eq_zero_iff), and the surviving blocks are characterised combinatorially — at X = Q^{-N} with N \geq 1 the Wedderburn blocks that survive are exactly the partitions with at most N columns, \lambda_1 \leq N.

It does not advance the open pair, and should not be cited as if it did. The substrate provably never lands on the Temperley--Lieb locus: substrate_avoids_tl_locus proves X \leq 0 \Rightarrow X \neq Q^{-N} for every N, so the stratification describes a region of parameter space the substrate avoids. The reachable counting statement counting_faithfulness_of_one_lt consumes only semisimplicity at q_0, already discharged by Wenzl genericity from q_0 > 1; knowing which blocks die elsewhere is not one of its inputs, and fewer surviving blocks would mean a smaller algebra — the tractable direction, not the hard one. Nor is it a counting-versus-decision statement, so it cannot supply the transfer. What remains open beyond all citation is unchanged: the pair displayed by faithfulness_of_transfer.

What the QOU actually proves (the derived result, not the Clay separation). Where the conjectured \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} needs the open counting\todecision transfer, a weaker but genuinely derived statement needs none of it. The observation trace at q_0 is \#\mathrm{P}-hard (above); if extracting the degree-0 answer requires the full 3^{3n}-leaf surviving resolution tree, the Bekenstein bandwidth bound forces any bandwidth-limited device to run super-polynomially — no bandwidth-limited device decides the boundary problem in polynomial time. This physical-intractability theorem is proved sorry-free (QOU.Information.qou_physical_intractability_unconditional; the exponential-domination fact it rests on is proved, superPoly_two_pow). It is strictly weaker than abstract \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} — a general Turing machine is not bandwidth-limited — but it is derived, not assumed. Combined with Turing-completeness (every q \neq 1 substrate is universal) and Gödel incompleteness, it yields the framework's strongest honest claim: a Turing-complete QOU necessarily hosts a non-empty jet horizon where degree-0 truth is inaccessible (geometry of incompleteness). That existence statement — not the Clay separation — is what the QOU stands behind.

The fourth millennium evaluation. The QOU obstruction reduction conjectures that all classical-limit obstructions map to the scalar class \chi(A) \in HH^2 \cong k, so that \mathrm{P} vs \mathrm{NP} becomes a fourth restriction of the same class alongside RH, NS, and BSD. The proportionality of the four evaluations is part of the conjecture, not a consequence of it.

Corollary (conditional). If the obstruction-class conjecture holds, resolving \mathrm{P} vs \mathrm{NP} constrains RH, NS, and BSD and vice versa, their evaluation maps differing but the underlying class remaining identical. The corollary inherits the conjectural status of its hypothesis.

Parallel route. This obstruction-class formulation is one of two independent attacks on the same separation. The Reeb--surreal route (P vs NP in the QOU) instead recovers \mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} as the standard part of a strict \mathbf{P} \subsetneq \mathrm{BQP}_q inclusion, via the surreal squeeze \mathrm{ord}_\omega(\text{cost}) > \mathrm{ord}_\omega(\text{budget}). The two carriers agree on the conclusion but neither is derived from the other; both remain open.

Shared substrate. This separation is the polynomial-rate leg of the shared length-filtration trichotomy on the Skein substrate \mathcal{S}(q) (one length filtration, three problems): \mathrm{P} vs \mathrm{NP} asks whether the observed degree-0 answer is reachable within a polynomial crossing-number budget, rather than the naive 3^c resolution leaves — the same filtration that q-Collatz asks to descend and q-Navier--Stokes asks to stay bounded. All three are three predicates on one shared object, QOU.Information.SkeinObservationSystem, on which the P-side is PolyObservable and the boundary reformulation is prop:p-vs-np-boundary.
